Author: Ravindra Maithani

 High Court Of Uttarakhand At Nainital
 Second Bail Application No. 12 of 2025
 Kshitij Chaudhary ........Applicant
 Versus
 State of Uttarakhand ........Respondent
 Present:-
 Mr. Abhishek Verma, Advocate for the applicant.

entities.text: High Court Of Uttarakhand At Nainital
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Mr. Siddharth Bisht and Mr. Himanshu Sain, Brief Holder for
 the State.

Applicant is in judicial custody in Sessions Trial No.105 of 2024, arising out of FIR No.118 of 2024,
under Sections 376, 323, 504 and 506 IPC, Police Station Premnagar, District Dehradun.
He has sought his release on bail.

2. Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.
3.
This is the second bail application.
The first bail application, being BA11 No.1441 of 2024, was rejected on 20.11.2024.

4. It is argued by learned counsel for the applicant that after rejection of the first bail application,
the victim was examined in the court as PW-1 on 21.11.2024.
On that date, she did not support the case with regard to the incident dated 05.10.2023.
5. These facts are not denied by learned State Counsel.
6. Having considered, this Court is of the view that it is a case fit for bail and the applicant deserves to be enlarged on bail.
